decisions.title: Use a single EC2 instance with Docker Compose
decisions.statement: A single EC2 instance is sufficient while horizontal scaling is unnecessary.
decisions.reason: Sustained host pressure is evidence that the original 'one instance is enough' assumption deserves review. This is a review trigger, not an instruction to adopt Kubernetes.

decisions.title: Use SSM Session Manager instead of SSH
decisions.statement: Administrative access must not require public SSH ingress.
decisions.reason: The workload deliberately uses SSM for administration, so opening SSH contradicts the accepted architecture decision.

decisions.title: Do not put real secret material in Terraform state
decisions.statement: Terraform must not own the value of a SecureString parameter. A provider refresh reads the decrypted value into state, so managing the resource at all puts the secret in state.
decisions.reason: The AWS provider reads aws_ssm_parameter with WithDecryption and stores the result in state. ignore_changes suppresses the plan diff, not the read.

acknowledgement.reason: Found while correcting the ADR itself. Separating ownership means moving parameter creation out of Terraform, which is not a change to make hours before a submission deadline.
acknowledgement.fingerprint_covers: 3 SecureString parameters managed by Terraform in infra/main.tf, none of them generating their own secret
